observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Outdoor paved courtyard with grass and trees in the background, with seated audience members watching a school or community event
observation.dancers: A group of young female dancers, mostly teenagers or older children
observation.formation_and_space: Initially standing in lines, later shifting into smaller groups and circles; they travel across the courtyard area
observation.posture: Upright torso, slightly bent knees with body weight shifting between feet
observation.footwork: Stepping side to side, gentle heel digs, and small steps timed to the beat; exact weight transfer cannot be fully verified due to video resolution
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held near the chest or extended out to the sides, hands clapping or holding small round flat props (plates/cymbals)
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains relatively upright with minimal isolated hip movement
observation.partnering: None in lines; brief hand-holding in small circles
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Dancers lower into a crouch/squat position briefly and perform circular turns
observation.costume_and_props: Red long-sleeved tops, draped cream or yellow garments/saris with red and black borders, patterned skirts, beaded necklaces, and some wear elaborate headdresses; holding small round metallic plates or cymbals
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement subtleties and weight shifts are partially obscured by long garments and low-resolution video sampling

signature_moments.what: Dancers clap their hands rhythmically while holding arms up near their chest in a lined formation
Dancers lower themselves into a low crouch while keeping their arms raised high above their heads
